prompts:
FIND: Every path in authorize.rs that can call issue_code or persist an authorization code, including GET and consent POST gates.
SCOPE: src/handlers/authorize.rs, src/auth.rs, tests/consent_flow.rs, tests/login_flow.rs
ATTENTION: Rust Axum OIDC; stale factor_epoch must never reach code issuance while base account sessions remain valid.
EXPECTED: entry-to-issue_code call graph with file:line and redirect behavior

FIND: Existing authentication gate helpers that delete invalid sessions and redirect to login while preserving authorize return_to.
SCOPE: src/auth.rs, src/handlers/authorize.rs, src/handlers/login.rs, tests/*.rs
ATTENTION: Reuse current redirect and cookie conventions without changing account-session semantics.
EXPECTED: helper candidates and test patterns with file:line
